identification: Framed original-looking watercolour of fairies/elves blowing bubbles on a lakeshore under big trees, signed lower right J Skerratt. Single photo, no size given. Style follows Outhwaite/Rentoul but the artist is unknown to me and no records were found. Could be a hobbyist or a modern decorative painter; a print is not ruled out from one photo.

entries.note: Framed painting of a fairy wren by Dianne Mathews with certificate. Not a fairy picture and a different artist; only shows what a modest signed framed decorative painting makes in the Hobart room. Hammer, premium extra. Seen via the local database and Gowans API, no page opened.

Genuine Ida Rentoul Outhwaite watercolour. NOT comparable to an unknown J Skerratt; shown only to mark the ceiling if the style were mistaken for the real thing, which it is not. From the local comps database, page not opened.

searches_tried: Local comps.py (pipeline and work) for skerratt, fairy watercolour, fairy, fairy artwork framed: no Skerratt sale anywhere. Gowans API for skerratt, fairy, fairies, elf, outwaite, rentoul: only this lot for Skerratt; no comparable fairy watercolour sold. WebSearch was refused (budget used up) so no web searches on the artist, Invaluable, Leski, Artrecord or Armitage past results were possible. eBay sold listings for 'skerratt fairy watercolour' and 'fairy elf watercolour signed framed' would help.
chrome_hint: eBay AU sold listings: 'J Skerratt fairy watercolour'; also Google Images/Artprice/invaluable.com search 'Skerratt fairies' and 'Skerratt watercolour Tasmania'
viewing_check: Check whether the picture is a true watercolour (brush texture, no printed dot pattern under a loupe) and photograph the signature, any date, and the back of the frame for labels, title, gallery or edition number. Note the image size.
